title: Google Maps Ask Maps Gets Major Update: Supports AI-Powered Phone Call Booking and Smart Itinerary Planning

content_html:
Google announced on November 16, 2026, a major feature update to its Gemini-powered Google Maps chatbot, Ask Maps. The tool can now not only find appointment services across categories such as beauty, pet care, automotive, and home repair, but also directly call local businesses to complete bookings and automatically gather the necessary information before displaying available time slots. At the same time, users can also use the feature to find real-time openings at restaurants in their saved lists.

For trip planning, Ask Maps supports generating road-trip routes based on user interests that can be modified, shared, or exported to Google Docs, and can provide “need-to-know” travel information such as weather, charging stations, and toll roads. The update is rolling out on Android and iOS starting today, with the booking and pre-trip route exploration features launching first in the U.S. market, while the service footprint of Ask Maps has also expanded to more than 30 European countries, including the UK, Germany, and Spain, covering more than 200 countries and regions worldwide.

This upgrade signals that AI map assistants are accelerating their evolution from basic information retrieval to end-to-end lifestyle service agents, further closing the loop between digital intelligence and the real economy.
